notes:
Quick notes from calls / internal context:
- Use case: automatically summarize inbound tickets & long email threads into 3-4 sentence digest + extract tags (product_area, priority, channel). Integrate back to Zendesk via app/webhook, map tags -> Zendesk ticket fields and triggers.
- Volume: 200-300 tickets/day today, expected 3x growth; peak scenario (promo) ~1500 tickets/hour for short windows. Need graceful degradation and fallback to lightweight extractors.
- Targets: summary quality = >85% CSAT on internal eval set; tagging precision >80% for top 10 tags; p95 latency for API summarization target < 1.5s; end-to-end (ingest->tag->apply_macro) goal < 2.5s for agent-facing flows.
- Reliability: must support retry/backoff for webhook failures, idempotency for duplicate events. Want automatic fallback to cheaper model variant when queueing >500 concurrent jobs.
- Security/compliance: must enforce SSO (SAML), KMS-managed keys for any persisted KV/caching, audit logs for every enriched ticket, retention controls per region (US-only customer data). SOC2 in evaluation.
- Integration details: currently on Zendesk (Enterprise), use Zendesk app + targets; also exploring Freshdesk for a small European subset. Want mapping UI for macros + ability to preview summary + suggested tags before apply.
- Quote from Head of Support: "We need summaries that save time for L1 without introducing noise — better to miss a tag than misroute a VIP ticket."
- POC success criteria: deploy sandbox connector, run 48h spike (synthetic) with no more than 1% failure, tagging precision >=80% on heldout set, sample of 200 agent feedbacks avg CSAT >=4/5.
- Ops ask: visibility into batching, cache hit rates (prefix caching), and per-model token cost breakdown. Want logging hooks to our Datadog.
- Blockers: legal asks for KMS + data residency answers; Zendesk sandbox rate limits (we may need a proxy queue).
- Next step: SE (Diego) to send POC runbook + deploy template; Security to review KMS plan by 2024-11-20.
